newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares edge up in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares edge up in moderate trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares edged up in moderate trade on Thursday, dealers said.
The group A index, which tracks the bourse's most active listings, rose by 18.66 points to 2,679 and overall central market volume was just over 2.4 million litas.
The rise was spurred by Lithuania Gas, which rose by 9.30 percent to 2.35 litas in trade of 510,521 litas.
Commercial bank shares remained quiet as investors wait for 1996 results to be released, dealers said.
Bloc trades of 970,000 litas were also made while volume on the secondary T-bill market soared to almost 12.7 million litas.
